location.parcel_note: SEC collateral schedule identifies the Calvert City real property as 35.6193 acres at 1035 Shar Cal Rd., owned in fee by American Property Acquisition, LLC, a Core Scientific Operating Company subsidiary.

status_as_of_cutoff: Operating 150 MW Core Scientific facility at Calvert City / Paducah-Calvert City. Current company and SEC materials confirm 150 MW gross utility / total power capacity, 15-acre campus footprint, 60,000 square feet, and one Kentucky facility; no official/local-government or company filing evidence was located that the older 300 MW 2025-2027 expansion plan has a project-specific permit, construction start, certificate of occupancy, utility energization, or completed buildout.
evidence_grade: B - company/SEC-confirmed operating facility; expansion beyond 150 MW remains unverified by project-specific government records.

actions.government_body: Core Scientific / U.S. SEC filing (company disclosure)
actions.result_status: Core’s filed infrastructure presentation identifies the Calvert City site as 150 MW and describes a planned 300 MW expansion during 2025–2027; the filing is not a Kentucky construction approval.
actions.access_caveat: SEC/company disclosure does not establish that the planned expansion was permitted, funded, built, or energized.
actions.evidence_note: Capacity plan is retained as a company claim, separate from county/city approvals.

actions.result_status: Core’s current Calvert City page identifies a 150 MW facility; it does not publish a building-level expansion permit, CO, utility interconnection, or commissioning record.
actions.access_caveat: Current company page is not a government record and does not confirm completion of the planned expansion.
actions.evidence_note: The 150 MW facility reference is not treated as proof that 300 MW is online.

actions.result_status: Core's 2025 Form 10-K lists Tennessee Valley Authority gross utility power capacity of 150 MW for Paducah-Calvert City, Kentucky as of December 31, 2025.
actions.access_caveat: SEC filing confirms utility capacity, not local construction approvals or energization of any additional expansion above 150 MW.
actions.evidence_note: Supports setting capacity_mw to 150 and keeping the 300 MW expansion as unverified.

actions.result_status: Core's Calvert City page, modified April 16, 2026, identifies Calvert 1, 2, & 3 with 150 MW total power capacity, 15 acres, 60,000 square feet, and address 1035 Shar-Cal Rd.
actions.access_caveat: Company page is not a government permit record and does not mention a 300 MW expansion as complete.
actions.evidence_note: Current public facility page corroborates the 150 MW operating capacity and address.

actions.result_status: City forms page lists planning, zoning, conditional use, variance, floodplain development, highway-oriented commercial criteria, zoning compliance, zoning ordinance/map amendments, and commercial-industrial water/sewer service request forms; no project-specific Core Scientific expansion approval was found on the public page.
actions.access_caveat: Forms page establishes the city review framework and was modified July 1, 2026; it is not a searchable permit ledger.
actions.evidence_note: Government-source check did not elevate the project to approved-permitted or construction status.

actions.result_status: Core reported Q2 2026 results, including AMD partnership capacity across five sites, approximately 1.1 GW leased customer power capacity, 437 MW billing as of mid-July, and facilities in seven states including one in Kentucky; the release does not identify a Calvert City-specific expansion beyond 150 MW.
actions.access_caveat: Portfolio-level capacity figures are not allocated to Calvert City.
actions.evidence_note: New company activity is treated as platform context only, not a Calvert City capacity increase.

owner: Core Scientific, Inc. / Core Scientific Operating Company; Calvert City real property held by American Property Acquisition, LLC per SEC collateral schedule.
